description: This Java class models the '<field-type>' element in an entity configuration XML, encapsulating its attributes and providing accessors.

classes.name: FieldType
classes.description: A thread-safe immutable class representing a field type configuration with attributes 'name', 'loader', and 'location'.

methods.name: FieldType
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a FieldType instance by parsing an XML Element and validating its attributes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the 'name' attribute of the field type.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Returns the 'loader' attribute of the field type.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the 'location' attribute of the field type.
